description: Sends a vMIDI stream out to a hardware MIDI device on the computer

inputs.text: Takes the vMIDI stream passed on to the chosen hardware device

notes: nothing leaves this module until a device is chosen from its right-click menu; the black strip at the top reads No Device until one is
menu: MIDI Driver - MIDI Output Device — chooses which of the computer's MIDI systems the device list below is drawn from
MIDI Outputs - Slot 1 — chooses the hardware MIDI output this module sends to; None disconnects it again
